authorized_scope.qualification: Post-result mechanistic follow-up on historically exposed development observations, not new independent confirmation.

hypotheses.fact: Binary SVC score columns are [-s,s]. Any legacy-anchor affine score map therefore gives calibrated class margin a*s+b. When a>0, ranking and AUROC are unchanged; the label effect is a threshold shift, not learned spectral geometry.
hypotheses.formula: a=C00-C01-C10+C11; b=intercept1-intercept0; threshold_on_s=-b/a. a=0 is constant margin; a<0 reverses ranking. Preserve class order.
hypotheses.test: Save anchor coefficient/intercept, derive a,b and reproduce every held query prediction from this scalar rule. Explicitly check a sign, matched zero-support vote/argmax, and class recall tradeoffs.
hypotheses.interpretation: Improvement over source scores establishes useful decision adjustment under declared labels; it cannot be called new feature extraction or probability calibration.

hypotheses.fact: Original sum-of-squares plus fixed lambda1 reduces penalty per example as 2K increases, while support composition also changes.
hypotheses.test: Fixed olddraw42 query per heldacid; same support pool;20 new support-order draws45..64; nested K0,1,3,5,10,20. Compare old anchorlambda1 against lambda_K=K/5 (matches old lambda1 at K5, constant lambda/n), bias-only ridge, balanced label permutation, explicit label flip, weaklambda1000/blend.05, and separately named full refit reference.
hypotheses.bias_only_formula: delta=sum(onehot(y_support)-source_scores,axis0)/(2*K+1); calibrated_scores=source_scores+delta. K0 is identity. All intercept coefficients penalized bylambda1.
hypotheses.null_policy: Only copied support labels supplied to the adapter may be permuted/flipped; originals remain unchanged. A balanced random permutation can be identity at K1: save changed-label count and do not pretend every null is wrong. Label flip is a deliberate incorrect-label control, not an empirical random-null pvalue.
hypotheses.decision_rule: True-label gain beyond bias-only/null, stable across support draws, supports label-dependent adaptation. If slope is positive and bias-only is comparable, describe threshold/location correction. Compare fullrefit separately and report gains plus losses, never select best K on query.
hypotheses.granularity: 15 source-score producer jobs (5heldacid x3modalities), then60 support chunks (4chunks x5draws per producer). Producers fit the fixed source once and save270 target IDs/scores; adapters consume only support scores/labels. Fullrefit K1/5/20 is a sufficient finite reference if approved in final protocol.

hypotheses.fact: Old acid6/24/60 intervention changed source normalizer, RBF gamma, source coverage and total class penalty as well as row count. Balanced class weights do not hold total penalty fixed: each class total is C*N/2.
hypotheses.test: 75 jobs=5heldacid x3modalities x5draws45..49. For each n6/24/60 use2x2x2 fixed source-only factors: StandardScaler fit subset/full246 donor rows; gamma scale from subset/frozen full-source gamma_ref; C10/C_n where C_n=10*246/(6+n). All source IDs and transformed input hashes recorded. n240 baseline reused once per15 producer; no redundant eight refits.
hypotheses.diversity_control: At n24 compare4acid-origin donors x6records against each one-origin x24records; freeze full-source scaler,gamma_ref,total penalty. Same6jujube donor rows and exact same270 query IDs remain.
hypotheses.decision_rule: Factor effects and interactions can separate source standardization/RBF bandwidth/regularization from donor coverage. Single-origin versus4-origin at equal n probes diversity. Do not rename the old count effect as a pure class-balance cause.

hypotheses.adopted_root_plan: 790DAG jobs: encoder/pretraining seeds42..49 x independent target seeds101/202/303 x5fixed folds x full/frozen x120/480steps, with A shared across step budgets;42 inherited sealed purepretraining producers and70 new purepretraining jobs;1680 fresh binary target trajectories.
hypotheses.requirements: A encoder initial seed must equal the corresponding pretraining seed, so all arms share initial encoder draw. Target head initialization, dropout RNG and epoch-order generator depend only on independent target seed and match across arms. All96target epochs fixed. Only pure source-pretrained encoders may be inherited; never inherit old query-finetuned target weights.
hypotheses.analysis: For each fixed setting, report paired B-A/B-Aextra/B-Bshuffle delta across8x3 randomization cells plus per heldsource. Summarize between-encoder-seed and within-encoder target-seed variation descriptively; seeds are not additional biological subjects.
hypotheses.decision_rule: Persistent sign across encoder and target seeds supports optimizer-stable conditional benefit on this development collection. A sign tied to pretrained seed points to representation variability; target-seed variability identifies adaptation instability. No global winner selection across the four old settings.

hypotheses.adopted_root_plan: 30BNprobes:5folds x3old encoderseeds42/43/44 x2new BN policies, t101,480step frozen; intact pretrained-BN results inherit from main790 endpoint only with exact gates.

policies.neutral: Set BN running mean0,var1,num_batches0, preserving all learned weights; this is an explicit new intervention, not a silent modification of old frozen-model qualification.
policies.source_recal: One complete target-donor batch only, no_grad, dropout disabled, BN momentum1. Preserve every parameter bitwise; allow and report deliberate BN-buffer changes, then encoder.eval/frozen for head fitting.

hypotheses.controls: Apply both policies to A/Aextra/B/Bshuffle. A-neutral can reuse A-intact only when full encoder state/scaler/fit IDs/head seed/order are exactly identical. Reuse is a no-new-fit result, not another independent model.
hypotheses.decision_rule: If B advantage shrinks after all arms get target-source BN recalibration, statistics/domain normalization contributed. Residual advantage with matched BN policy points to learned features. This does not identify physical instrument or botanical identity.

hypotheses.adopted_root_plan: No-new-fit sanity in source producers: source model/scaler remain unchanged; positive global per-row scale and constant offset copies of query undergo same rowSNV before inference.
hypotheses.fact: rowSNV(a*x+b)=rowSNV(x) for a>0 and constant b, apart from floating error. Thus original alpha norm association is not alone a causal pure-amplitude explanation for an alpha/SNV classification error.
hypotheses.qualification: Pure amplitude/offset invariance does not imply all thickness effects vanish: frequency-dependent interference, phase/scattering/inversion effects can alter shape. Artificial transformations are numerical engineering controls, not measured physical thickness or material authentication.

reporting_gates.scope: Fixed query sets before support selection; all learned normalizers, referencegamma, PCA, models and BN recalibration use donor/source/support only. No query labels in gradient or adapter entry.

metrics: macroF1 per replicate then descriptive mean/spread
prohibited_inference: No label reassignment from model consensus or adaptation success.
No best-K, best-seed or best-setting selection from query scores.
No repeated-row/seed count treated as new independent N.
No calibrated-probability, independent-batch or botanical-authentication claim.
Do not call step-matched pretraining exposure/FLOPs matched: original fold0Aextra batches6/32 versus B32/32 remain a qualification.
reporting_gates.complete_blocks: Require all frozen configuration/fold/seed/support cells before pooled comparisons; preserve partial or negative outcomes and cost, no retry for low accuracy.
reporting_gates.artifact_limits: Avoid prior4MiB JSON/5MiB return failures: shared ID tables and per-job compact metric tables; shard detailed raw predictions by known cohort/configuration, keep immutable input/old failure artifacts. New scientific code requires independent review and meaningful boundary tests before ROOT launch.
